//: ts-node settings for prisma/seed-admin.ts (`npm run db:seed:admin`).
The app's tsconfig.json targets Next: module=esnext, moduleResolution=bundler.
ts-node cannot execute that directly, so the seed scripts need CommonJS.
The existing `prisma.seed` hook passes the same override as an inline
--compiler-options JSON argument. That works when the Prisma CLI spawns it,
but NOT through an npm script: npm hands the command to cmd.exe on Windows
and to sh elsewhere, both of which strip the inner double quotes, and ts-node
then fails with `Expected property name or '}' in JSON at position 1`.
A project file has no quoting to get wrong and behaves identically on every
platform. It deliberately does NOT extend the app tsconfig — inheriting
module/moduleResolution is the exact thing being overridden.
